leads.why: They are running Padel and Prosecco, a Diva ladies Americano and two Racket Rumbles in the next week, some still with open spots.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Padel Perfect has Padel and Prosecco and the Racket Rumbles coming up this week. I could shoot a quick reel of one of them to help fill the spots for the next ones.

leads.why: A single-court club with no website or Instagram listed, so players only find it through the booking app.
leads.opener: Hi, I came across Rivonia Padel on Playtomic and saw you run a singles court in Morningside. A short reel of the court and a few rallies could give people a reason to book it over the bigger clubs.

leads.why: Five courts with regular socials like the Ladies Coffee Club, Kholie's Americano and Before Work Social every week.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Club Padel at Morningside Country Club runs the Ladies Coffee Club and the Before Work Social. Weekly reels of those socials could keep the spots full, and we do a padel league package at R2500 a week.

leads.why: Weekly Sunday runs with an After Shuffle coffee social and DJ sets, a very visual community that lives on Instagram.
leads.opener: Hi, I love the no podiums, no egos idea behind Sunday Shuffle. I would like to shoot a Sunday run and the After Shuffle social so you have a proper reel and photos for the summer season.

leads.why: Their Wednesday runs pull 200 to 300 people with a social after, which is a big group to capture well.
leads.opener: Hi, I read that your Wednesday runs now get 200 to 300 people. That crowd would make a great reel and photo set, and I could shoot one of the evening runs and the social after.

leads.why: Saturday 6am runs through Braamfontein, a strong city backdrop for content.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Braamfie Runners head out every Saturday at 6am through Braamfontein. The city at sunrise with your crew would make a great reel, and I would like to shoot one for you.

leads.why: Weekly Wednesday evening runs in Sandton, a social club that grows through people sharing photos.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw The Social Runners meet every Wednesday evening in Sandton. I could shoot a run and send you a reel plus photos people can tag themselves in, which helps new runners find you.

leads.why: Runs twice a week from Rosebank Mall, tied to a store, so good content helps both the club and the shop.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Shelflife Running Club meets at Rosebank Mall on Wednesdays and Saturdays. A reel of a Saturday run could help the club and the store at the same time, and I would love to shoot one.

leads.why: They run almost every day of the week in Rosebank, so there is a lot happening that could be shown.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Run Tell That runs most weekdays in Rosebank. I could shoot one of the sessions so you have fresh photos and a reel for the end of year push.

leads.why: A women only Saturday run club, where good photos help new women feel welcome to join.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw The Pack runs every Saturday at 7am in Rosebank. Some relaxed photos and a short reel of a run could help more women feel comfortable joining you.

leads.why: Tuesday time trials and a Homerun series at Pirates, regular events that suit a recap reel.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Pirates runs Tuesday time trials and the Homerun series. I would like to shoot one of the time trials and give you a short recap reel and photos for the members.

leads.why: They do ceramic coating and paint correction, work that sells best with before and after video.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw The Car Barber does Gyeon ceramic coatings and paint correction. Before and after reels of that work do really well, and I could shoot one on your next car.

leads.why: A detailing business in Inanda with no Instagram linked on its listing, so the work is not being shown.
leads.opener: Hi, I came across Deluxe Shine Kustoms in Inanda. I shoot car content in Joburg and could do a short reel of one of your details so people can see the finish.

leads.why: They do wraps, PPF and tinting, which are very visual jobs that sell through reels.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Onyx Auto SA does wraps and PPF in Kyalami. A reel of a wrap going on from start to finish could bring you a lot of new work, and I would like to shoot one.

leads.why: They offer wraps, PPF, tint and ceramic packages, all jobs that look great on camera.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw D2 Customs does vinyl wraps, PPF and ceramic packages. I could shoot a reel of your next wrap or ceramic job so your Instagram shows the full process.

leads.why: A new Stellantis dealership opened this year with six brands, including Leapmotor, which needs launch and stock content.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw the new Stellantis showroom at Bidvest McCarthy Centurion with Jeep, Peugeot and Leapmotor. I shoot car reels and could do walkaround videos of new stock for your socials.

leads.why: Relaunched at Steyn City in October after moving from Maboneng, so the new space needs fresh photos.
leads.opener: Hi, congrats on the move to Steyn City. I would like to shoot the new space and a jazz evening so you have fresh photos and a reel for the festive season.

leads.why: Their Veranda rooftop is being promoted for year-end parties of up to 100 guests.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw the Veranda rooftop is taking year-end bookings for up to 100 guests. I could shoot one of the functions so you have real photos and a reel to sell next year's bookings, and I can also offer it to your clients.

leads.why: They are pushing private year-end functions and launches for up to 270 guests.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Katy's Palace Bar is taking year-end functions and launches. I do event photo and video from R1500, and I could be a supplier you recommend to clients booking with you.

leads.why: A corporate function and party venue in its busiest season right now.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw LUXX is listed as a year-end venue in Sandhurst. I would like to shoot one of your functions this season so you have new photos and a reel, and I can offer the same to your clients.

leads.why: Offers exclusive hire for year-end groups of up to 70, with a cold plunge and sauna room that is unusual to show.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw The Edge is doing year-end hire with the Resilience Room. A short reel of a group using the space could sell it better than words, and I would like to shoot one.

leads.why: A newly opened seafood restaurant running a king prawn special, which needs good food content.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Tightline recently opened at Sandton Gate with the king prawn special. I could shoot a quick reel of that dish and the room to help get the word out.

leads.why: Opened their first walk-in bakery shop on 26 October and launched a frozen range.
leads.opener: Hi, congrats on opening the new bakery shop and the frozen range. I would like to shoot the shop and the bread so you have a proper set of photos and a reel for the new space.

leads.why: Just opened a third branch on 4th Avenue in Parkhurst.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Tea and Antique opened a third branch on 4th Avenue. I could shoot the new Parkhurst space and some of the tea service so people see it before they visit.

leads.why: Moved from Braamfontein to a new home in Blairgowrie, open Friday to Sunday.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Beijing Opera has moved to Conrad Drive in Blairgowrie. I would like to shoot the new space and a few dishes so your regulars can see the new home.

leads.why: A newly opened Italian restaurant on Jan Smuts Avenue.
leads.opener: Hi, congrats on opening La Scala. I shoot food and restaurant content in Joburg and could do a reel and photo set of the room and a few plates for the festive season.

leads.why: Expanding with a new spot at Polofields Crossing in Waterfall after Bryanston.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Kolonaki is opening at Polofields Crossing. I would like to shoot the new space and your meze so the opening has strong photos and a reel.

leads.why: A newcomer on 4th Avenue in Melville that is still building its audience.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Scala opened on 4th Avenue in Melville. I could shoot a short reel and some photos of the food and the street vibe to help more people find you.

leads.why: A new Belgian chocolate and waffle cafe, a product that looks great on video.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Vidi Vici brought Belgian chocolate and waffles to Nelson Mandela Square. Slow motion chocolate pours make great reels, and I would like to shoot a few for you.

leads.why: A new neighbourhood spot doing hand-cut pasta and hand-rolled sushi.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Nina opened at The Woods with hand-cut pasta and hand-rolled sushi. A reel of the pasta and sushi being made could do really well, and I would like to shoot one.

leads.why: A coffee shop under a year old that is getting press for its JuiceBox drink.
leads.opener: Hi, I read about your JuiceBox at Pulse99. I could shoot a short reel of it being made plus a few photos of the shop, a Mini Shoot is R500 for 30 minutes.

leads.why: A bushveld wedding venue outside Pretoria East that is pushing a 2026 winter wedding offer.
leads.opener: Hi, I saw Simbali is promoting its 2026 winter weddings. I shoot weddings and could do a styled shoot or video of the venue to help sell those dates.
